label: review-audit
command:
import json
import re
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

root = Path.cwd()
evidence = root / "docs/validation/2026-10-23-evidence-preservation"
records = [json.loads(line) for line in (evidence / "checks.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
labels = [r["label"] for r in records]
assert len(labels) == len(set(labels))
expected = {
    "rendering-red": (1, False),
    "focused-sandbox": (-9, True),
    "lint-initial": (0, False),
    "typing-initial": (1, False),
    "format-initial": (2, False),
    "probe-sandbox": (-9, True),
    "probe-host": (0, False),
    "focused-host": (1, False),
    "focused-host-corrected": (0, False),
    "lint-final": (0, False),
    "typing-final": (0, False),
    "format-final": (0, False),
    "recorder-static": (0, False),
    "recorder-format": (0, False),
    "recorder-typing": (0, False),
    "full-test-host": (0, False),
}
assert set(labels) == set(expected), labels
for record in records:
    label = record["label"]
    assert (record["exit_code"], record["timed_out"]) == expected[label]
    assert record["environment_keys"] == ["PATH"]
    assert (evidence / f"{label}.log").is_file()
assert "562 passed" in (evidence / "full-test-host.log").read_text()
assert "24 passed" in (evidence / "focused-host-corrected.log").read_text()
print(f"PASS: all {len(records)} retained check records, outcomes, and output files")

document = evidence / "README.md"
references = re.findall(r"\]\(([^)]+)\)", document.read_text())
for reference in references:
    if reference.startswith("https://"):
        continue
    assert (document.parent / reference.split("#")[0]).resolve().is_file(), reference
print(f"PASS: {len(references)} documentation references (local files exist; live sources reviewed separately)")

for private in (".env", "REFACTORING_PLAN.md"):
    subprocess.run(["git", "check-ignore", "-q", private], check=True)
    assert subprocess.run(["git", "ls-files", "--error-unmatch", private], capture_output=True).returncode != 0
print("PASS: dotenv and local plan remain ignored and untracked")

changed = subprocess.check_output(["git", "diff", "--name-only", "HEAD"], text=True).splitlines()
new = subprocess.check_output(["git", "ls-files", "--others", "--exclude-standard"], text=True).splitlines()
allowed = {
    "backend/src/incident_copilot/agents/prompts.py",
    "backend/tests/unit/agents/test_evidence_preservation.py",
}
for name in set(changed + new):
    assert name in allowed or name.startswith("docs/validation/2026-10-23-evidence-preservation/"), name
    path = root / name
    assert path.is_file()
    assert not re.search(r"sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}", path.read_text()), name
print("PASS: changed/new files stay within prompts, evidence tests, and this task's validation directory; credential-pattern scan clean")
subprocess.run(["git", "diff", "--check"], check=True)
print("PASS: git diff --check")
